# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `insurmagic` MCP server pointing at HalloFelix's hosted endpoint (`https://app.hallofelix.de/api/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with HalloFelix account sign-in — no API key to configure.
- Logo: HalloFelix mark from the publisher's `timgutberlet/hallofelix-mcp` repository.
